extra.reason: Golden log demo/agent_planner.golden.jsonl checked in; the demo suite replays it and asserts a drifted demo diverges at the first mismatched call; the record/replay workflow is documented in docs/tool-effects.md. The tests follow the existing erlc-absent skip, so they go green in CI once hir-33w.7 lands.

New beam job in .github/workflows/ci.yml installs OTP 28, runs runtime/test.sh, then the workspace suite with erlc on PATH; HIRD_REQUIRE_BEAM turns the erlc-absent skip into a failure so a broken toolchain install cannot pass green. Verified locally: a one-token encoder change in hird_types.erl fails runtime/test.sh; the guard panics with erlc off PATH and skips as before when unset. Branch protection still needs the 'erlang runtime and BEAM tests' check added to required status checks.

The demo suite fans demo/agent_planner.golden.jsonl out over the demo and two variants of it (a ticket for every task; the ticket announced before it is filed). The unmodified demo is the control and replays green; announce-first parts at call 2 with a tool_mismatch, eager at call 4 with an args_mismatch, and the test asserts that summary plus the crash naming both the expected and offered call. docs/tool-effects.md gains a 'Record once, fan out' section explaining the pattern, its shell-loop harness, and its two limits (decisions not outcomes; replay stops at the first departure). Runs in CI with the rest of the BEAM-dependent suite.

All eight children landed: the dispatcher records err-tagged results and rethrows; --audit-file routes the stream to an append-only file; hird_replay decodes a log type-directedly at startup and matches it strict-sequentially ahead of handler resolution; --replay drives it, failing a run on divergence or on a log left unconsumed; demo/agent_planner.golden.jsonl is replayed as a regression golden and fanned out over demo variants as an evaluation pattern; the beam CI job runs the runtime eunit suites and the BEAM-dependent workspace tests with HIRD_REQUIRE_BEAM so a missing toolchain cannot pass as green; docs/audit-evidence.md states the stream's guarantees, non-guarantees and wire-format stability policy, and the README leads with deterministic replay of real agent traffic. Verified end to end: a recorded run replays byte-identically bar timestamps, a short log diverges, a long one fails finish. Left open deliberately and documented as v0.1 limitations: replay is whole-log (no prefix-then-live, no per-tool selection), and divergence-report ergonomics stay provisional pending more real runs.

Topics, Discussions, and the social preview image are live and verified over the GitHub API. The homepage URL is intentionally still unset and carried by hir-zj6.11, which repoints it once the launch page ships.
